```{python}
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt

data = pd.DataFrame({"x": range(10000)})
alt.data_transformers.enable('default', max_rows=20000)

alt.Chart(data).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X('x:Q', bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=50)),  # histograma de x
    y='count()'
).interactive()
```
